title: SAHG: Sector-Anisotropic Hyperbolic Graph Model for Social Bot Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.30166v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM-driven social bots can generate fluent, human-like text, reducing the discriminative advantage of content-based detection alone. However, coordinated campaigns still leave relational patterns -- interactions, behavioral similarity, shared neighborhoods, community positions, and coordinated activity -- that graph-based methods can exploit. Existing graph detectors face two challenges when exploiting such evidence. First, Euclidean GNNs distort hierarchical and scale-free social graphs; while hyperbolic geometry addresses this volume-growth mismatch, fixed-curvature models still assign uniform geometric resolution to structural directions with different densities and separation needs. translated_title: SAHG：面向社交机器人检测的扇区各向异性双曲图模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.30166v3 通告类型：replace-cross 摘要：由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的社交机器人能够生成流畅的、类人风格的文本，这削弱了仅基于内容进行检测的判别优势。然而，协同行动仍会留下关系层面的模式——交互行为、行为相似性、共享邻域、社区位置以及协同活动——这些证据可以被基于图的方法所利用。现有图检测器在利用此类证据时面临两大挑战。其一，欧几里得图神经网络（GNN）会扭曲具有层级性和无标度特性的社交图；尽管双曲几何能够解决这种体积增长不匹配的问题，但固定曲率的模型仍对不同密度和分离需求的结构方向赋予统一的几何分辨率。其二，关系证据并不总是可靠的：高明的社交机器人会与真实用户建立伪造的异配连接，导致邻域聚合过程混合了机器人与人类用户的信号，从而稀释了账户层面的证据。我们提出了SAHG（扇区各向异性……
tldr: 该论文提出扇区各向异性双曲图模型SAHG，通过双曲几何适配社交图的层级无标度结构，并利用各向异性的曲率区分不同结构方向的密度差异，同时缓解社交机器人伪造异配连接导致的邻域信号污染问题，从而提升社交机器人检测的准确性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SAHG, a sector-anisotropic hyperbolic graph model that adapts hyperbolic curvature anisotropically to structural directions of hierarchical, scale-free social graphs while mitigating unreliable relational evidence caused by bots forging heterophilic connections, thereby improving social bot detection.
